program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((code (at g 0 0)))
    (define (apply-cmd grid code)
      (cond [(= code 1) grid]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= code 4) (rotate-ccw grid)]
            [(= code 5) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (flip-ud grid)]))
    (apply-cmd (crop-to-content (set-cell g 0 0 0)) code)))
